threat_event: CRE Lending funds a loan to an attacker's account on spoofed or compromised-mailbox disbursement instructions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Funding on emailed instructions; callbacks to numbers in the closing package; closers not in payment-fraud training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-R1; SYS-G4; funding wires through the bank
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 225 App. F III.C); UCC Article 4A as enacted in each state (Fla. Stat. ch. 670 worked example)
existing_controls: Funding checklist; dual approval of funding requests
treatment_plan: Independent callback standard; bank verified-instruction service; closer training (POAM-019)
owner: Director of loan closing and funding

threat_event: A title or escrow agent's email is compromised and sends changed wire instructions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agents' security is outside group control
treatment_plan: Wire instructions only through the secure closing portal; no changes within 48 hours of closing
owner: Director of loan closing and funding

threat_event: A stolen closer session exposes guarantor personal information in mailboxes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mailboxes hold years of closing packages with guarantor financial statements
regulatory_driver: State breach notification laws (generic; Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example); N52-R02 (12 CFR 225 App. F II.B)
treatment_plan: Device-bound sessions (GR-02); mailbox retention labels; inbox-rule alerts (POAM-020)
owner: Commercial Real Estate security and compliance lead

threat_event: Guarantor financial statements are kept in mailboxes indefinitely
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention rule for closing packages
regulatory_driver: State breach notification laws (generic); N52-R02 (12 CFR 225 App. F III.C)
treatment_plan: Move closing packages to SYS-R1 document storage; 7-year retention then deletion (POAM-023)
owner: Director of loan closing and funding

threat_event: Division staff follow the acquired company's 2023 policies instead of group policy
owner: Commercial Real Estate security and compliance lead

threat_event: Nobody can show which group controls protect division systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No inheritance matrix; no assessment before 2026
owner: Commercial Real Estate security and compliance lead

threat_event: A loan servicing SaaS outage delays investor remittances
The building access control system is compromised
existing_controls: Separate network segment; vendor access through PAM

threat_event: A building automation controller is used as a network foothold
Stale local accounts in the lease system
Changes to funding instructions in the loan system are not reviewed
treatment_plan: Daily report of funding-instruction changes reviewed by a second closer (POAM-020)
owner: Director of loan closing and funding

threat_event: The single alarm monitoring vendor for all branches fails
existing_controls: Vendor redundancy in two monitoring centers
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Commercial Real Estate security and compliance lead (Low)
owner: Commercial Real Estate security and compliance lead

threat_event: The CRE underwriting assistant (AI-008) misreads rent rolls and influences credit decisions
A suspicious activity report for a nonbank subsidiary is late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CRE fraud cases handled by the bank's BSA team informally
treatment_plan: Written routing of CRE cases to the nonbank BSA/AML Officer
